Carla M.: Heads-up — slim cutover at 23:00 UTC to route 4.1 traffic to blue pool. Need final signoffs and the safety-button plan.
Ben T.: On call for the window, I can hold rollback if we see errors.
David R.: I can own smoke for latency + error-rate. I’ll kick off checks 2 mins after cutover.
Emma S.: Security/keys check done, KMS health green. Verified key rotation not active. :lock:
Carla M.: Quick checklist (please ack each):
- [ ] Deploy manifest applied to staging and greened? -> Ben
- [ ] Canary traffic validation scripts ready? -> David
- [ ] Feature flag toggle prepared (name: runtime_4_1_live)? -> Frank
- [ ] Alerting runbook linked in PagerDuty incident? -> Emma
- [ ] Emergency rollback script present and tested? -> Ben
Ben T.: staging manifest ✅ applied (image tag runtime-4.1.3-slim).
Frank L.: Flag toggle verified in FF service, default off, rollout schedule set.
David R.: Canary validation: I have the script at repo: https://git.redwood/ops/runtime-canary and will run `./validate_canary.sh --latency 150` after cutover.
Emma S.: PagerDuty link added: https://pd.redwood/INC12345. Runbook step 3 updated with post-cutover trace tags.
Carla M.: deploy-bot, please create canary with 1% traffic and post status.
deploy-bot: Canary created: id=canary-3877654321-01, target=1% traffic, health checks: ok -> 0/0 failed (will report live).
Ben T.: Emergency rollback: `scripts/rollback_to_4.0.9.sh` validated in staging. I’ll be prepared to run it and will announce when executed.
Frank L.: I’m available as feature-flag owner for the first 30m after cutover.
David R.: Acks: manifest ✅, canary script ✅, smoke owner ✅. I’ll post smoke results in this thread.
Carla M.: All set. Final acks please (thumbs only) when ready and I’ll flip the switch at :23:00 UTC.
Ben T.: :thumbsup:
David R.: :thumbsup:
Emma S.: :thumbsup:
Frank L.: :thumbsup:
Carla M.: Flipping in 3...2...1... now.
deploy-bot: Route update applied to blue pool, rollout=1% -> 4.1.3-slim. Health checks: passing.
David R.: Smoke run results: latency p95 = 120ms, error rate 0.03% during first 5m. All good.
Carla M.: Thanks team. Keeping an eye for 30m then ramping to 50% if stable. If anyone sees anything urgent, mention @here and trigger PD.
Ben T.: I’ll keep my terminal open.
Frank L.: Monitoring FF toggles, will pause ramp if needed.
Carla M.: Closing thread — will post ramp update at +30m. :white_check_mark:
